item.title: Nekonade Distortion Ren'ai Jishou no Dead End
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Whitesoft
  • 発売日: 2015-05-29
  • スコア: 6.17/10 (18 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 猫撫ディストーション 恋愛事象のデッドエンド
  • 英語名: Nekonade Distortion Ren’ai Jishou no Dead End

あらすじ

This is a crowdfunded fandisc for Nekonade Distortion. One day, Tatsuki’s childhood friend Yuzu turned into his little sister “Kotoko”. When he went to his mother Shikiko for advice, she was “Kotoko” as well. Then his older sister Yui showed up in front of him… as “Kotoko”. Everyone that he knew had turned into “Kotoko” on the inside.

あらすじ

It was April and the first year for Haruka and his younger sister Rise at Sotoorihime Academy, which is surrounded by beautiful cherry blossoms. First meetings with new friends awaited them, as well as reunions with childhood friends. And, as if it was waiting for this exact moment to come, the synchronicity of love begins.

あらすじ

This is the fandisc for Gangsta Republica, with Sharka being upgraded from a sub-character to main heroine. Walking the dog, replacing the sliding door, babysitting. It’s another day of ‘bad’ deeds by the Gang Club. However, there is one thing different: his senpai Sharka is doing a ‘homestay’ at his house for various reasons. Even though there are many problems living together, their days are happy ones. But those days are gradually threatened by something unknown to them: “the Angel of Hipparcos”.

item.title: Gangsta Republica
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Whitesoft
  • 発売日: 2013-07-26
  • スコア: 6.7700000000000005/10 (69 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ギャングスタ・リパブリカ
  • 英語名: Gangsta Republica

あらすじ

There once was a relatively unknown rumour that those who cannot cast aside the dirt from their hearts should visit that shop and they will meet friends one day. Most people did not pay attention to this vague rumour, but for those who hold a different disposition, this was how they found friends.

Kanae was in the “Charity Club” room at Seitengi Gakuen, wondering if there was anything bad that was going to happen. The students and teachers did not view the noisy club as an official one, especially since he calls it the “Gang Club” himself. The club’s slogan was to “change the world with evil”. For example, to play with kids and steal their valuable time as a child, or to help an old lady with her moving and to cheat her out of candy in return. That is their “evil” and it is this “evil” that makes the club members friends. Welcome to their gangster republica.

item.title: Nekonade Distortion Exodus
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Whitesoft
  • 発売日: 2012-02-24
  • スコア: 7.06/10 (34 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 猫撫ディストーション Exodus
  • 英語名: Nekonade Distortion Exodus

あらすじ

The sequel to bestselling eroge Nekonade Distortion, Nekonade Distortion Exodus continues the story of the Nanakase family, which consists of one lucky guy and four moe girls. But this is no mere “moe game”, as fans of the series know. Exploring complex themes in science and philosophy, Exodus is sure to give you much food for thought as you experience the moving story of a family struggling against the omnipotent “system” that runs the world. Of course, there’s plenty of moe content too! Each of the game’s five heroines gets her own romantic story packed with lively dialogue, cute scenes, and tons of fun and varied sex - twice the sex scenes of the first game!

item.title: Love-Bride Eve
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Whitesoft
  • 発売日: 2011-08-26
  • スコア: 6.2700000000000005/10 (37 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ラブライド・イヴ
  • 英語名: Love-Bride Eve

别名

  • ラブライド・イヴ～love-bride eve～

あらすじ

Atsushi and Miyu are childhood friends who are known as the perfect couple by friends and family. They’ve been together since they were small, live next to each other, and are often teased by others for acting like newlyweds. However, there’s one big problem. They’ve never properly confessed to each other. Even though they are so lovey-dovey, it is too embarrassing for them to say those few words, believing that they do not have to say it because they know it deep down. However, Miyu wants to one day have the courage to say the words “I love you”.

  • 日本語名: 猫撫ディストーション
  • 英語名: Nekonade Distortion

あらすじ

Tatsuki’s imouto Kotoko is striken with an incurable disease and spends every day in her room reading books. He told himself not to enter her room to avoid giving her any stress. One night, he saw lots of shooting stars in the sky and wanted to let her know since she loved seeing pictures of stars and space. When Tatsuki opened her door, he found Kotoko without any vital signs. He blamed himself for causing her death.

item.title: Little Rabbits -Wagamama Twin Tail-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Whitesoft
  • 発売日: 2010-05-28
  • スコア: 6.1/10 (25 人評価)
  • 日本語名: りとるらびっつ -わがままツインテール-
  • 英語名: Little Rabbits -Wagamama Twin Tail-

あらすじ

Miyako loves her onii-chan Ryoutarou a lot, more than just as siblings, and makes daily advances on him. Somehow he’s been able to withstand her temptations, but now his older sister Azusa is coming back for the summer vacation and she loves him just as much. He decides that he can’t keep going on like this and decides to get a girlfriend – his kind classmate Rina. However, this only makes things worse as his sisters team up with his osananajimi Sayo to gain his attention. Even though he has a girlfriend, it doesn’t matter… They will keep loving him!
